figures.finding: A resident's comprehensive income (pay, labour-service fees, author's remuneration and royalties, combined for the year) is taxed from 3% up to CNY 36,000 to 45% above CNY 960,000, after a standard basic deduction of CNY 60,000 a year and other allowed deductions; there is no provincial or local income tax.

sources.said: For residents, employment income, remuneration for labour services, author’s remuneration, and royalties are combined as 'comprehensive income' for aggregate tax calculation purpose on an annual basis.
The amount of the standard basic deduction is CNY 60,000 per annum (i.e. CNY 5,000 for monthly tax withholding purpose).

figures.finding: The tax year is the calendar year; the annual reconciliation return is filed between 1 March and 30 June of the next year.

sources.said: The filing period for the annual reconciliation tax return is between 1 March and 30 June of the following year.

figures.finding: Social insurance is set by local rules: in Shanghai, Beijing and Guangzhou the employee pays about 10.2% to 10.5% (8% pension, 2% medical, unemployment) and the employer about 24% to 28%, on a monthly base capped at CNY 27,549 to CNY 41,112 depending on city and item.
figures.applies: Rates and caps valid as of 30 June 2026; elsewhere the local rules apply. The self-employed and performers' terms were not read.

figures.finding: The payer withholds provisional tax from a resident's pay, fees, author's remuneration and royalties; for a fee or author's remuneration it deducts CNY 800 (receipt up to CNY 4,000) or 20%, a further 30% for author's remuneration, and withholds 20% on author's remuneration and royalties.
figures.applies: Provisional; settled in the annual reconciliation. The Guangdong bureau states the labour-service prepayment scale; the CNY 800 or 20% deduction, the author's 30% reduction and the 20% on an author's pay and royalties rest on PwC.

sources.said: If the gross receipt is not more than CNY 4,000, a deduction of CNY 800 is allowed. If the gross receipt exceeds CNY 4,000, a deduction of 20% is allowed. A further reduction of 30% is allowable for author’s remuneration. Provisional tax at a flat rate of 20% should be withheld from the taxable income of author’s remuner

figures.finding: Author's remuneration is part of comprehensive income at 3% to 45%, but only 70% of the 80% left after the expense deduction is taxed (a further 30% reduction).

sources.said: Author's remuneration is subject to the progressive tax rates of 3% to 45% applicable to comprehensive income.
A further reduction of 30% is allowable for author’s remuneration.

figures.finding: An individual providing services is a small-scale VAT payer at 3%, cut to 1% from 1 January 2026 to 31 December 2027, and exempt while monthly sales stay below CNY 100,000 (CNY 300,000 a quarter); general payers charge 6% on most services.

sources.said: An individual is deemed a small-scale VAT payer subject to the VAT rate of 3%.

For the period from 1 January 2026 to 31 December 2027, the VAT rate for small-scale VAT payers is reduced from 3% to 1% (not applicable to the sale or lease of immovable properties or transfer of land-use rights). During the same period, small-scale VAT payers are exempt from VAT if the sales amount is below certain thresholds: Monthly sales amount below CNY 100,000 (or quarterly below CNY 300,000, depending on the VAT declaration period adopted).
